frequency_question: How often do central banks initiate rate hikes during similar domestic expansionary cycles within a comparable timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes sovereign emerging market central bank monetary policy committee decisions where the policy rate was below long-term neutral and inflation printed above target; excludes emergency pandemic interventions and sovereign debt crises.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; represents all comparable domestic tightening cycles under the flexible inflation targeting framework.
known_gaps: Excludes minor mid-cycle pauses, focusing purely on rate-hike initiation points.
skeleton: 3 distinct monetary tightening cycles initiated by the RBI over the past 24 years under similar structural inflation targets.
multiplier: 3 cycles / 24 years = roughly one major cycle initiation every 8 years.
validity_reason: Monetary policy frameworks and inflation-targeting mandates remain stable over multi-year horizons.
